gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: For every proleptic year in a range that spans the BC/AD boundary, a date built from the proleptic year must agree with the equivalent date built from its era a
ADDED i2: The proleptic year is preserved verbatim.
ADDED i3: Non-positive proleptic years fall in the BC era, positive years in AD.
ADDED i4: BC counts backwards from year 1, so proleptic 0 -> year-of-era 1, -1 -> 2, etc.
ADDED i5: Building the same date via (era, year-of-era) must yield an equal date.
